newsitem.title: USA: BMW offers side air bags on 3-series cars.
newsitem.headline: BMW offers side air bags on 3-series cars.

text.p: BMW of North America Inc on Friday said it was making side-impact air bags available as an option on its 318i and 328i sports sedans, beginning with cars produced this month.
The company set a price of $385 for the option.

BMW said the 318i, which carries a base price of $25,950, will become the least-expensive automobile in the United States available with side air bags. Side air bags are already standard on BMW 5-Series and 7-Series models.
The air bag systems, mounted on the front doors, are only available on 3-Series four-door sedans. They are not available on 3-Series coupes and convertibles, nor on the 318ti hatchback.
